limitations: Finite public-source subsets, not the complete Spanish language, proof of conversation or exhaustive factual/rights certification.
Original historical works include old spelling/science/social views; Tatoeba is a first100000-row source shard, mainly sentences dated2007-2012, not guaranteed current2026 facts.

Exact UTF8 whole-record and whitespace-normalized paragraph guards do not detect semantic paraphrases. Initial seed has raw full-record digests and normalized paragraph digests, not normalized full-record digests across changed multi-paragraph separators.
Paragraph checks cover original blank-line blocks and individual lines of at least12 Unicode words; shorter packed sentences are not compared as substrings.
No historical TEST text is read; individual reserved TEST paragraphs/chunks are not exhaustively checked. IDs/folds already assigned remain preserved.
Samefold known paragraph content may remain in a different new record and is reported; it is not proof that every word or sentence is new.
OASST rehearsal is repeated only for retention and is never counted as new diversity; source contributors/attribution/licenses remain perrecord.
Mixed source licenses are not relabeled to a single blanket data license; see the exact pinned source manifests.
